title: GTA6: Rockstar Drops 30 Stunning New PS5 Screenshots
description: Rockstar Games has updated its official website with 30 brand new GTA6 PS5 screenshots following last week's Extended Look, showcasing incredible visual details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6: Rockstar Drops 30 Stunning New PS5 Screenshots

Following last week's mind-blowing Extended Look, Rockstar Games has treated fans to an even deeper visual feast by adding 30 brand new *GTA6* screenshots to its official website, according to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square.

### Official High-Res Confirmation of Social Media Leaks

Some of these newly released images were initially shared exclusively among select influencers. As a result, eagle-eyed fans may have already spotted a few of these assets floating around on various social media platforms in recent days—such as the highly detailed iguana screenshot that caught the community's attention. Now, these captivating visuals have been officially confirmed and published in high resolution for the public.

### Building Momentum for the Open World

This steady stream of official material highlights Rockstar's calculated approach to building anticipation for *GTA6*. By following up a major promotional drop with a massive gallery of direct-feed PS5 screenshots, the developer continues to fuel intense discussions regarding the game's graphical fidelity, lighting, and environmental density.

## Editor's Take
Dropping 30 new screenshots right on the heels of an extended look is a masterclass in community engagement. Seeing these images transition from exclusive influencer previews to official website assets gives players a clearer, breathtaking look at what the PS5 hardware can achieve. It's an exciting time to follow the game's ongoing rollout.
